conclusion: Standalone retention improves over the previous fixed noise-calibration rule, notably SVHN/DTD. RawAGA protection persists. MNIST/SVHN output-calibrated protection is weaker than the previous point; cannot claim uniformly better defense. DTD retains an evaluated MNIST partner, but not all task pairs preserve partners. Known-location recovery and SVD contribution remain separate.
method_scope: Finite hinge objective and native-source acceptance were changed together; no isolated attribution to one component. Phase2 ray only guarantees decreasing synthetic quadratic while keeping finite conditions, not constrained stationarity or natural accuracy.
next_research_question: The fixed finite requirement improves native retention but sacrifices calibration resistance on MNIST/SVHN. Before a new candidate, analyze why source classification success fails to transfer to independent natural calibration; do not tune confidence or select earlier iterates from these test results. Keep all three releases and existing threat-model comparisons.

prodistill.scope: Additional64 unlabeled official training images per task and task identity; published weights, public base and coefficient gradients. No class labels or clean target teacher available to attack. Two-expert adaptation of a merger used for recovery; not a new attack algorithm.
prodistill.conclusion: Fixed64 unlabeled training images per task restore near-unprotected MNIST/SVHN performance and substantial DTD performance. Same frozen Defense2 versions; no new defense tuning. This does not erase the low originalAGA/calibration results but limits recovery robustness.
prodistill.mechanism_conclusion: Outside residual blocks the merged states equal matching controls. SVHN/DTD blocks0-10 are bit-identical; MNIST blockwise relative differences are at most1.15e-7. Block11 remains20.2%-33.0% distant while classification recovers. Every changed B and output-bias coordinate has nonzero public-base difference; unconstrained elementwise coefficients can represent arbitrary values there in real arithmetic, not a finite-budget recovery guarantee.
